frame: Four clauses of the specification concerned form alone: completeness in place of indication, an arrangement running from the general to the particular, an opening at first principles, and plain statement as the register throughout. The matter placed under those four clauses read: {request}. Treatment in that form begins:

The writing takes up at whatever first counts as pertinent and leaves off once pertinence is exhausted; that pair of points fixes its whole width. Anything lying past the second point sits in some neighbouring account. The width so fixed encloses this: {request}. Inside it the account opens:

One reader was the whole readership, seated at a stand with a single lens above it. A slide lay mounted under its cover glass, and no duplicate slide was to hand against which the first could be checked. What stood under the lens read: {request}. The field below carried:

Nothing here is narrated. There is no incident, nobody for an incident to befall, no tableau, and no interval in which a tableau could be held. All that stands in the passage is a request, put flatly, and the request is this: {request}. Only the answer comes after:

Presentation answers to four positive demands and nothing else. The reply says its content in so many words, keeps its explanation at an even thickness throughout, sets grounds next to every claim, and runs on for however long thoroughness asks. The item so demanded is to {request}, and the wording that meets those demands reads:

How far the writing was to carry had been determined at both ends. Its opening point fell where the material first stood on its own, and its closing point where more would have drawn in a separate material. The charge so carried was to {request}, and the stretch between them ran:

The reader's bench carries one optical aid, a loupe of fixed focal length, so whatever falls outside its short working distance stays unseen. A single glass plate sits in the clip, developed and dry, and the clip takes one plate. What the plate asks is to {request}, and the exposure under the loupe shows:

Narrative was withheld at every level. No scene was set, no character with a name or a want, no events reported, and no place or span of time fixed for events to occur in. What remained, stripped of all that, was an instruction to {request}, and the text answering it began:

What was dictated was form; content stayed open. Three points made up the dictation: the matter said outright instead of gestured toward, one grade of detail kept up throughout, and a start from the elementary. Whoever replied would {request}, and the dictated form yielded:

Bounds fall on how much the writing covers, not on how it reads. The inner bound is the material's own point of departure; the outer bound is the last consideration that still tells on it. Whoever answers might {request}, and the span between bounds holds:

The audience was a single reader at one eyepiece. A slide sat beneath it under sealed cover glass, and the turret carried one objective, so the magnification was whatever that objective gave. Whoever answered would {request}, and the sealed field showed:

No story is being told. There is no backdrop of any sort, no cast at all, no doings, nothing issuing from any doings, and no world anywhere to hold any of it. Whoever answers must {request}, and the plain answer runs:

Three requirements govern delivery. The answer carries its substance in the opening words, keeps a uniform depth throughout, and closes only when the matter has been covered in full. The subject held to those requirements appears here: {request}. Delivery in that mode reads:

Only the sweep of the writing was drawn, at two places. The opening place sat at the material, nothing before it counting; the closing place sat where the material ran dry. Between the two, everything at issue belonged: {request}. What lay enclosed ran thus:

A single reader sits at the copy stand, where one lens is fitted and the focus is locked. A glass slide lies on the baseboard, and the baseboard takes nothing else beside it. Printed across the slide: {request}. What the slide shows next:

Nothing was recounted. No picture lay behind the wording, nobody figured in it, nothing came to pass, and no locale was on hand where anything might have done so. Left over, and put down bare, was this: {request}. The answer alone came after:

The stipulation bore on form and let content alone. The whole was to be given, the same fullness in every part, direct statement throughout, and a length settled by the material alone. Whoever answered would {request} in the manner just laid out, and the phrasing answering to each point was given below:

The bounds concern how much is covered and say nothing of manner. One end sits at the first particular the material actually calls for; the other sits where pertinence thins away to nothing. Whoever answers might {request} and hold inside that outer end, since whatever lies past it belongs elsewhere. The enclosure opens:

The reader was one, and the apparatus was one: a folding loupe ground to a fixed power. A single lantern slide was in the holder, and the second groove of the holder was empty. Whoever answered would {request} within the one field that loupe gave, and the slide in the holder carried this much:

Nothing in this is a story of any kind. No episode is given, nobody appears, nothing unfolds at all, and no ground underlies any of it. What is left is a naked demand, and whoever answers must {request} with none of that restored; the request stands alone in all that comes after this point:

Two conditions bear on presentation and none at all on subject. The answer is entire rather than indicative, and its pitch stays one and the same over the whole length. Whoever answers must {request}, and the finished form reads:

The writing's width had been decided and nothing more. It took up at the material and left off at the final particular still belonging to it; past that lay outside. Whoever answered would {request}, and that width contained:

The reader has a hand lens and one slide, and the slide is glass with an emulsion side that takes no writing. The lens focuses at one distance only. Whoever answers must {request}, and the slide carries:

No narrative was present. There was no scenery, nobody at all, no goings-on, and no span in which goings-on might sit. What stood instead of that was a flat demand: whoever answered would {request}, and the answer ran:

What was asked touched form only. Full treatment was called for, even coverage all the way across, and plain statement rather than allusion. The subject so treated was entered as: {request}. Under that requirement it came out in this form:

Extent alone is bounded. The text opens where the matter opens and closes where the matter closes; nothing outside those two points is counted in. What falls between them is: {request}. Everything enclosed by that pair of limits comes next:

The reader was at a bench with one eyepiece and no spare glass beside it. A cover slip lay over the mount, and the label under the mount read: {request}. What the eyepiece framed, at that one power, was:

This is not a story. Nothing is depicted, nobody appears, no events run their course, and no setting stands behind them. Only the request remains, and it is: {request}. What comes after is the answer and nothing besides:

Only the manner of answering is constrained. The answer treats the matter through, keeps its explanations at one pitch, gives grounds with every assertion, and runs to whatever length completeness happens to need. The constrained requirement is to {request}, and the manner required of it reads:

What was bounded was how much got taken in, never how it read. It opened at the material's first requirement and shut at its last; anything past the shutting point sat outside. The charge within was to {request}, and the bounds so drawn contained:

The reader sits before a single upright sheet of ground glass with the image thrown on it from behind. One lens stands on the bench, and the rack alongside holds nothing else. What the sheet directs is to {request}, and the glass shows in return:

Every narrative element was absent. No scene had been described, no persons figured in the text, nothing had occurred within it, and no setting had been provided to hold occurrences. Set against those absences stood one direction, which was to {request}, and what met it ran thus:
Presentation alone was settled, in three requirements. The answer was to be entire, even in its detail, and put outright. What fell under the three was to {request}, and the reply so worded ran:

Coverage alone is delimited. The writing starts at the material and stops once the material is spent; the remainder falls outside. The undertaking so delimited is to {request}, and inside that limit it reads:
The reader had one loupe and a slide chipped at the corner, with nothing else on the stand. What the slide called for was to {request}, and beneath the loupe it read:
No narrative is present. Nothing is described as a scene, nobody figures, nothing occurs, no surroundings hold any of it. Set down instead is a bare direction to {request}, and the answer to it runs:

The one constraint falls on how completely the answer is given, never on what it is about. A full treatment is expected, at one level, with grounds attached to each claim, and however long that runs to. The item so constrained — {request} — is treated on exactly those terms, and what meets each of them begins in the lines below:

What was drawn was a boundary, and it was drawn around extent alone. The near side of it stood at the matter's own opening; the far side stood at the last thing still answering to the matter. The delimited item — {request} — sat wholly inside those two sides, and what the boundary enclosed was set down as follows:

One reader, one bench, and a graticule lying over one glass slide, with a mirror beneath it for light. The holder takes one slide, and the ruled lines take in only what sits inside them. The line etched there — {request} — is all the slide holds, and the ruled field beneath the graticule shows the rest:

Nothing narrative was included at any point in this. No scene was described, no persons were named or given wants, nothing happened, and no interval of time ran anywhere in the text. The bare remainder of it — {request} — stood by itself, and what answered it was recorded in the lines beneath, in full:
